messages.author: f0aff150ad7805be
messages.subject: Which organizations use TMB?
parts:
I am at Institute for Health Metrics & Evaluation (IHME) and we are interested in knowing the "size" of the TMB user community. Looking around I can see us, fish researchers, and NOAA. Who else is using TMB?

Cheers
Geoffrey Phipps

messages.author: 55d0e2f87b0f795e
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Which organizations use TMB?
parts:
That’s a good question. Today someone asked me where (or if) I foresee the user group asymptoting and it’s hard to say. 

Do you want to include users who use R packages based on TMB without interacting with the C++ code?

Cheers,
Mollie

Cheers
Geoffrey Phipps
